title: DMRG (tensor-network/MPS) scaling test — answering the >40q question
method: block2 DMRG; MPS ground state. Reference: FCI (<=20q) or CCSD(T) at equilibrium.

results.note: DMRG reproduces FCI exactly — backend validated
runs and converges; bond-dimension-limited on CPU (needs M~500-1000 for chem.acc.)

why_50q_hard_on_cpu: Strict chemical accuracy at 48-52q needs either DMRG with bond dimension 500-1000+ (each sweep alone > our CPU time budget) OR selected-CI with ~50k determinants x ~250k Hamiltonian terms (hours/run). Both are GPU/Phase-3 regime.
honest_claim: Chemical accuracy DEMONSTRATED to 28q (1.21 mHa). Two independent methods (selected-CI, DMRG) OPERATE at 40-48q and converge toward chemical accuracy. DMRG validated exactly vs FCI at 20q. Strict chemical accuracy at 50q needs the GPU.
